mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscle bundles to the skeleton was most worthwhile because the two views showed how pulls on opposite sides move the elbow differently.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones at the elbow was straightforward and left little to decide, although the picture clarified the joint's parts.

surprise.text: I was surprised that hardened bone still contains living cells and blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary: the goals and pictures explained the pairings.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter because building the arm connected its parts to a movement I recognize, though the pairings were mostly obvious.
